_meta.source: Round 12 - Direct CDS PDF extraction (WVU, UNM, Wyoming, WSU, UNH, URI)
_meta.purpose: State university residency admit rates from official CDS PDFs

schools.notes: WVU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 20150 (in-state 3485 / oos 15652 / intl 1013), admitted 15570 (in-state 2572 / oos 12629 / intl 369). OOS rate HIGHER than in-state (WV is small state, school recruits nationally). Intl 36.4%.
UNM CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 13125 (in-state 6502 / oos 5851 / intl 772), admitted 10431 (in-state 5304 / oos 4883 / intl 244). Intl notably lower (31.6%) vs domestic (81-84%).
Wyoming CDS 2024-25 C1: applied in-state 1670 / oos 4316 / intl 230, admitted in-state 1625 / oos 4176 / intl 222. Near-open admissions for all groups (96-97%).
WSU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 25462 (in-state 15085 / oos 9598 / intl 779), admitted 22060 (in-state 12996 / oos 8425 / intl 639). All groups ~82-88%, slightly open admissions.
UNH CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 21175 (in-state 4499 / oos 16189 / intl 487), admitted 18667 (in-state 3873 / oos 14376 / intl 418). Near-open admissions; OOS 88.8%, intl 85.8%.
URI CDS 2023-24 C1 (most recent available): applied in-state 4330 / oos 20634 / intl 427, admitted in-state 3286 / oos 15971 / intl 311. Intl 72.8%, similar to domestic rates. 2023-24 cycle.
